state:
**Side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks`: stages 2, 3 and 4 have landed. The one thing left is shape types as lists.** `nvs fmt` lays out lists (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs`), `->` / `?->` call chains, and `&&`, `||`, `??`, `.` chains, plus broken conditions (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/chain.rs`).

*Put on separate lines* and *Join onto one line* are offered for lists, call chains, operator chains and broken conditions. `chain::seams_on` names each place a line break sits at a chain's own level. `nvs_fmt::relayout` (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/split_join.rs`) picks the innermost list or chain around the cursor, writes or removes the breaks, and formats the file. `rule:ide/a-list-splits-onto-lines-and-joins-onto-one` is `shipped`, with five `.lspt` cases under `tests/lsp/actions/`.

The rustdoc gate is green (`bun nv verify --doc`).

`rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line` stays `designed` because shape types are not laid out yet. The gap name `comma-separated-list-whose-closing-delimiter` is used only in this handoff. No gap record under `data/gaps/` carries it.

next.title: a shape type is a list

items.text: **A shape type is one line or one field per line** (`rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line`). A shape type has no node, so its `{` cannot be told from a block's (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs:54`). Find its braces from the type's own span, then admit it in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs:91` `writes_a_list`. Split and join then come with it through `crates/nvs-fmt/src/split_join.rs`.

**Ship the list rule** once shape types hold: set `status` to `shipped` in `data/rules/tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line.json:3`, rewrite the "Not yet a list here" paragraph at `crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs:52`, then run `bun nv rules --render`. After that, check whether the goal is met (`bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes fmt-layout-from-breaks`) and write `DONE`.
